stem: The alkanes are a homologous series of organic molecules. Alkanes are generally unreactive and are commonly used as fuels.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Give two reasons to explain the general unreactivity of alkanes.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
Alkanes with low relative molecular mass, $M_{\text{r}}$, are more useful than those found in heavier crude oil fractions.

Name the process that is used to obtain alkanes with low $M_{\text{r}}$ from heavier crude oil fractions.
